coordinate_system.bounds: [x0,y0,x1,y1] in [0,1]; operations apply sequentially to the current image

policy: Every transform is pinned to the verified source SHA-256.
Generated derivatives are candidates until separately visually reviewed.
Do not auto-approve a transform merely because it removes known text regions.
Masks must not overlap architecture evidence.

transforms.rationale: Remove the lower-left Titanic Bricks maker logo/text while preserving the complete figure and all visible ball-joint architecture evidence.
